key_insight: FlowMesh generates thermal-fluid fields on fixed unstructured meshes, achieving 91.7–97.0% PDF coverage and 585–1902× speedups over CFD.
engineering_relevance: Fast full-field sampling could support distributional analysis and digital twins for reactor cooling channels and industrial heat exchangers.
method: Deterministic latent flow matching without grid interpolation or stochastic denoising
L1 regularization of learned transport velocity
evidence_signal: Across cavity, reactor-subchannel and heat-exchanger datasets evaluated over six matched training seeds, FlowMesh exceeded an architecture-controlled latent diffusion model by 11.6–45.4 percentage points in macro-averaged PDF coverage.
watch_item: The reported framework targets fixed meshes; generalization to unseen geometries or changing meshes is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Flow Mesh: A Velocity-Regularized Flow Matching Framework for Stable Distributional Modeling of Physical Fields on Unstructured Meshes
